def get_sheet_path(title):
    ws = wb[title]
    p = getattr(ws, 'path', None)
    if p:
        p = p.lstrip('/')

        wbxml = z.read('xl/workbook.xml').decode('utf-8')
        m = re.search(r'<sheet\b[^>]*\bname="' + re.escape(title) + r'"[^>]*>', wbxml)
        if not m: return None
        elem = m.group(0)
        rid = re.search(r'\br:id="(rId\d+)"', elem)
        if not rid: return None
        rels = z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels').decode('utf-8')
        m2 = re.search(r'<Relationship\b[^>]*\bId="' + re.escape(rid.group(1)) + r'"[^>]*>', rels)

        target = re.search(r'\bTarget="([^"]+)"', m2.group(0)).group(1)
        if target.startswith('/'):

        elif not target.startswith('xl/'):

        return target
